section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces a study investigating the impact of error management instructions and goal orientation (learning, prove, avoidance) on performance during computer program training. A randomized experiment with 87 participants compared three training conditions, finding superior short- and medium-term performance for participants receiving error management instructions. The study also observed interactions between prove/avoidance goal orientation and training conditions, and it advocates for an error training approach.
